# Getting help

This repository is the shared Rust core of the District AI desktop apps
(District AI for Linux and District AI for Windows), the clients of District AI,
the AI voice receptionist from Distronode. Where to go depends on what you are
asking about.

- **A question about District AI, the product** (your account, numbers, plans or
  billing): <https://www.distronode.com/support>. This repository is client code,
  not the product desk.
- **A bug you see in one of the apps:** report it in that app's repository
  ([District AI for Linux](https://github.com/distronode-corporation/district-linux/issues),
  [District AI for Windows](https://github.com/distronode-corporation/district-windows/issues)).
  If it turns out to be here, we move it.
- **Questions, build trouble and ideas** about these crates ("how do I", a build
  that fails, a change an app needs):
  [this repository's Discussions](https://github.com/distronode-corporation/district-core-rust/discussions).
- **A reproducible bug in these crates:**
  [this repository's Issues](https://github.com/distronode-corporation/district-core-rust/issues),
  with the bug report form. Leave out tokens and anything about the people your
  workspace talks to.
- **A security vulnerability:** report it privately through
  [GitHub's private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/distronode-corporation/district-core-rust/security/advisories/new),
  or, if you cannot use GitHub, email opensource@distronode.com. See
  [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md). Never open a public issue for one.
